messages.content: Hello, I need help with business valuation
I'd be happy to help! What is your business's annual revenue in SGD?
Great! What is your net profit or EBITDA in SGD?
Thank you. What industry is your business in?
How many years has your business been operating?
What is the estimated value of your business assets (equipment, inventory, etc.)?
Is your business revenue growing, stable, or declining?
Are there any customer concentration risks or other risk factors I should know about?
Top 3 customers account for about 40% of revenue
